draft.quote: The NOC condemned the closure of a valve carrying oil from the Sharara field
draft.summary: Libya's National Oil Corporation says a valve carrying oil from the Sharara field has been closed by a group of outlaws for more than two weeks. The NOC says the closure has cut about 15,000 bbl/d and raised the country's total daily output loss to 350,000 bbl/d. The NOC condemned the closure and urged security forces to protect oil facilities.
